model: multi-agent collaboration: a primary orchestrating agent dispatching specialized execution agents (research, economic mechanism, spatial design, GIS engineering, visual engineering, narrative, independent review). Individual agents run on Anthropic Claude models; no single model produced this package.
author: UncleJ-h
submission_method: Package assembled by an orchestrated multi-agent workflow. Geometry computed with shapely/pyproj in EPSG:4548 from OpenStreetMap current-condition data; metrics recomputed from the submitted geometry; all figures generated programmatically from the same geometry and metrics. Independent review agents audited the package separately from the agents that produced it.
